units: <cite ref="Yoma 72b:19">Ib.</cite> <he>רוֹקֵם מעשה וכ׳</he> the embroiderer’s is needle work, therefore it has only one face; a. e.
Ps. CXXXIX, 15) to form the limbs of an embryo, shape.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 29">Lev. R. s. 29</cite>, beg.; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 46:1">Pesik. R. s. 46</cite> <he>שלישית ביום צבר … רִיקְּמוֹ</he> at three hours of the day he gathered his (Adam’s) dust, at four he kneaded him, at five he shaped him; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 92:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII</cite> <he>חמשית … ששית רקמו</he> at five he made him a shapeless body, at six he articulated him. Y. Bets. I, 60ᵃ <he>בצים שרִיקֵּימוּ גוזלים שלא העלו עליהן וכ׳</he> (not <he>העליהן</he>) eggs which developed chicks without a formation of wings.
<cite ref="Chullin 64a:7">Ḥull. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>אם רִיקְּמָה וניקבה</he> if the egg had developed a distinct embryo, and was perforated; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>מְרוּקָּם</he>; f. <he>מְרוּקֶּמֶת</he>.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 7:1">Esth. R. to III, 1</cite> <he>עשה לו צלם מר׳ וכ׳</he> he (Haman) made himself an image embroidered on his garment over his breast.

<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 3:3">Nidd. III, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Niddah 24b:46">24ᵇ</cite>) <he>ואם היה מר׳</he> and if the fœtus was articulated. Y. ib. 50ᵈ top, v. <cite ref="T01075"><he>רָשׁוֹן</he></cite>. Tosef. ib. IV, 12.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 9:6">Ḥull. IX, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Chullin 126b:11">126ᵇ</cite>) <he>ביצת השרץ המר׳</he> the egg of a creeping thing (serpent &c.) in a developed state; a. e.
